sections.content: Combine *porque* and por *eso* with the pretérito indefinido to recount an unexpected goodbye. Explain why the event happened, describe its consequences, and include simple emotions to make the narrative meaningful.

items.spanish: Recibió una noticia, por eso se fue.
items.english: She received some news, so she left.

items.spanish: Se fue porque recibió una noticia.
items.english: She left because she received some news.

items.spanish: Entendió la situación, por eso lloró.
items.english: She understood the situation, so she cried.
She cried because she understood the situation.

sections.content: Use *porque* to give the reason. Use por *eso* to introduce the consequence. Do not use por eso when you mean because.
